decks.notes: This deck revolves around quickly ramping up mana with creatures like Elvish Mystic and Birgi, God of Storytelling, while also generating card advantage with Risen Reef and Collected Company. The goal is to use Eldritch Evolution and Wish to find key combo pieces like Devilish Valet or Runaway Steam-Kin, which can be used in conjunction with Hazoret's Monument to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Grinning Ignus to generate additional value and support the combo strategy.

The deck focuses on using Greasefang's ability to generate tokens and create value while combining it with the powerful vehicles like Parhelion II and Skysovereign. The main goal is to assemble a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes cards to search for key pieces like Traverse the Ulvenwald and utilize graveyard recursion with Bitter Triumph and Sheoldred. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures, versatile vehicles, and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage. With the ability to manipulate the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategy, it aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant position. The inclusion of a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. By carefully managing resources and making strategic decisions, the pilot can outmaneuver their opponent and secure victory by outlasting them. Patience and careful planning are key to success with this deck.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells while drawing cards and generating value through card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents for extra triggers. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage, utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. With a mix of interaction, card draw, and value engines, this deck aims to grind out victories in a slow and methodical manner, overwhelming the opponent with its resources.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to consistently deal damage early in the game, using cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to apply pressure, while also utilizing powerful burn spells like Wizard's Lightning and Play with Fire to finish off opponents. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to maintain a fast-paced and aggressive strategy to secure victories in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to outmaneuver the opponent by predicting their moves and reacting accordingly. The deck also includes cards that provide card advantage and recursion to maintain control of the game. The mana base is built to support a variety of colors to ensure the deck has access to all necessary resources. The strategy revolves around staying one step ahead of the opponent while slowly chipping away at their resources and maintaining a strong board presence.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle, using creatures like Callous Sell-Sword, Emberheart Challenger, and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage quickly. With support from spells like Monstrous Rage and Titan's Strength, along with removal options like Fatal Push, the goal is to maintain pressure and control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the strategy focuses on relentless aggression and efficient card synergy to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and powerful combat tricks. The deck aims to deal damage as quickly as possible while utilizing cards like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage to pump up creatures and push through for lethal damage. With a focus on aggression and burn spells, this deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional value and flexibility to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively buff up creatures with powerful aura enchantments, while also utilizing Sram, Senior Edificer for card draw and Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion to provide additional mana. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with strong, enchanted creatures like Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice and Optimistic Scavenger, supported by a mix of protection spells and mana sources to keep the pressure on and secure a fast victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor out powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy with control elements. By sacrificing smaller creatures, the player aims to bring out higher-costed threats quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds additional value through flickering creatures and generating card advantage. The deck includes a mix of versatile creatures and enchantments to provide both offensive and defensive capabilities, ensuring a well-rounded approach to controlling the battlefield and outmaneuvering the opponent.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to overwhelm the opponent. The main strategy revolves around playing control and disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to protect the combo pieces, while also using Raffine's Informant and Cache Grab to find key cards. The deck includes a mix of black, green, and white mana sources to support the various spells and creatures in the deck, with a balance of card advantage, removal, and proactive threats to disrupt opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss in combination with other cards to quickly ramp up to powerful threats like Parhelion II while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Cache Grab for removal and card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to support both black and green spells, with the potential for Boseiju, Who Endures to provide protection for important combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful combination of creatures and disruption.

This deck focuses on controlling the game while ramping up mana with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Lotus Cobra. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells, while also using Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value and card advantage. The deck utilizes a mix of removal, card draw, and powerful creatures to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent, ultimately securing victory through a combination of board presence and card advantage.

The concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures, utilizing burn spells and combat tricks to clear the way for damage. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds extra flexibility and consistency to the deck. The deck aims to consistently deal damage early in the game and finish off the opponent before they can establish a strong defense. With a mix of creatures, burn spells, and efficient land choices, this deck is ready to attack and push through to victory.

The deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, backed up by burn spells and combat tricks like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage to push through damage. With Jegantha as a companion, the deck ensures consistency by having a guaranteed source of mana. The mana base is optimized for quick, efficient plays to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. Overall, the deck aims to close out the game as quickly as possible by applying constant pressure and leveraging combat tricks for maximum impact.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a resource advantage. The companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides additional value and synergy with the deck's creatures. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the game.
